# Multiplying Disciples

> Multiplying Disciples helps ordinary Christians move from learning about
> disciple-making to actually doing it. The site pairs simple, biblical
> disciple-making tools with live practice labs so believers can share the
> gospel, make and train disciples, and start simple churches that multiply.

Everything here is built around one conviction: every disciple can share the
gospel, disciple others, and gather people around Jesus — no title, degree, or
permission required. The tools are simple and reproducible; the labs give
people reps and coaching with a real person they know.

- [Home](https://multiplyingdisciples.us/): what the site is and how the labs work
- [Start Here](https://multiplyingdisciples.us/start-here/): the first step for a new visitor
